situation: Friends going to a football match.
topic: What is the bag size limit at the Emirates Stadium?

text: Anyone know the bag size limit at the emirates? Want to bring my rucksack for the match
I think they're strict about bags now?? Not sure what size tho 🤔
dunno, i've only ever taken a little crossbody. would a rucksack be fine?
@claude what's the bag size limit at the emirates stadium

Arsenal's guidance, as the search results describe it, is that bags can be no bigger than A4 (21 x 29.7cm). A typical rucksack is probably too big, and a small crossbody is fine. I didn't open the official page myself, and one guide said A5, so check before you go: https://help.arsenal.com/support/solutions/articles/101000546310-what-can-i-bring-into-the-stadium-
